svg.aria-label: How to connect a coin cell to the Reference 620 cable: the present cable has five 2 mm banana plugs without clips, and the black lead has a clip. As a stopgap, use alligator clips with 2 mm sockets: clip the current leads to the centers of the two flat faces and clip the sense leads onto the current clips; do not clip the rim. Recommended: buy a four-wire coin cell holder. Red to the negative cap current contact, white and orange to the negative cap sense contact, blue to the positive case sense contact, green to the positive case current contact. 4 mm sockets need 2 mm female to 4 mm male adapters.
